regions.today: A bit fresher today with a mix of sunny spells and scattered passing showers. Highs of 16 to 18 degrees with moderate to fresh northwesterly winds.
regions.tonight: Showers will become more isolated with longer dry and clear spells developing. Lows of 9 to 12 degrees with moderate westerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: It will be mostly dry tomorrow with a mix of cloud, sunny spells and some passing showers. Later in the day, cloud will increase from the west and the odd spot of drizzle is possible. Highest temperatures of 17 or 18 degrees, with mostly moderate west to southwest breezes, freshening later.
